prompt:
Using the kibana tools, work on Kibana's web-logs sample data (data view 'Kibana Sample Data Logs', index kibana_sample_data_logs). Do these steps in order:
1. Describe the data view 'Kibana Sample Data Logs': look up its fields and name its time field. End your reply with a line of the form TIME_FIELD: <field name>.
2. Build a dashboard titled 'LOC-95041e38 Web logs' on that data view with exactly two panels: the number of requests over time, and the number of requests by HTTP response code.
3. Create an alert rule named 'LOC-95041e38 5xx errors' on the web-logs data for the signal of the response-code panel: it checks every minute and fires when more than 10 requests with a 5xx response code arrive within 5 minutes. The rule must be enabled when you finish: if it is created disabled, enable it.
4. Edit the response-code panel of that dashboard: change its title to 'Responses by code'. Then read the alert rule back and check that it is enabled. End your reply with a line of the form RULE_ENABLED: yes or RULE_ENABLED: no.
Use only the kibana tools. When every step is done, reply with a short summary.
failure_reason: describe: answer None, expected 'timestamp'; rule: no rule; edit: no successful update_panel call; edit: no successful get_alert_rule/list_alert_rules call; edit: answer None, expected 'yes'; edit: no panel titled 'Responses by code'; edit: no rule
